description: Arabic text utilities. mode "clean": remove tashkeel (harakat and Quranic marks, optionally keeping shadda), remove tatweel (kashida), normalise letters (alef with hamza/madda/wasla → bare alef; alef maqsura and Farsi ya → ya; ta marbuta → ha; hamza on waw/ya → waw/ya), switch Latin , ; ? to Arabic punctuation, and convert digits (Arabic-Indic ↔ Western). mode "arabizi": turn Arabizi / Franco-Arabic chat text (mar7aba, 3arabi, 5ala9, el bait) into Arabic script. Returns the result with letter/word/character counts. Give "text" or a text file "path". Web version: https://s3eidat.github.io/arabic-tools/

arabicPunctuation.description: clean: Latin comma, semicolon and question mark → Arabic ones.

digits.description: clean: keep digits, convert Arabic-Indic/Persian digits to 0-9 ("western"), or 0-9 to Arabic-Indic ("arabic").

keepShadda.description: clean: when removing tashkeel, keep the shadda.

mode.description: "clean" = clean & normalise Arabic text (default); "arabizi" = Arabizi (Latin letters + numbers) → Arabic script.

normalizeAlef.description: clean: alef with hamza above/below, madda or wasla → bare alef.

normalizeHamza.description: clean: hamza on waw → waw, hamza on ya → ya.

normalizeYa.description: clean: alef maqsura and Farsi ya → Arabic ya.

output.description: Optional: write the result to this file path (or folder ending in "/") instead of returning it.

path.description: Or: a path to a UTF-8 text file.

name: text_arabic
title: Arabic text tools
